params.message:
Fix publish switch rendering as a native checkbox on top of the track

#cars_table input[type=checkbox] is an ID selector that outranked the
single-class .ui-switch-input rule hiding the native checkbox, so the
switch added in #415 showed a visible 15x15 checkbox layered on the
drawn track (square left edge, knob overlapping the pill). Excluded
.ui-switch-input from the row-selection checkbox styling.
